notes.title: Sword x Hime 1.12.5
notes.notes:
[New] Added Steam Input support.
Developer's Note: After many attempts and studies to find the best game controller input solution, we found that Steam Input is the best choice. Steam Input offers superior functionality, interface, customization, compatibility, and consistency compared to our in-house development. Thus, we are officially launching it in version 1.12.5.
The official Steam Input setting is available, and players using game controllers can simply turn on Steam Input (enabled by default). The Steam Client will automatically fetch the configuration from the cloud. If you find that our official settings do not suit your gameplay habits, you can customize them through Steam Input.

[b]On the Sword x Hime game launch page in the Steam Client, there is a joystick icon button on the right. Clicking it will take you to Steam Input.[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38709307/76227a38cbaf3f71ff641e06dffd95a29dab080b.jpg[/img]


[New] Added a feature that shows the current H state on buttons during H-action playback.
[Fix] Fixed the issue where the Bunny Girl would turn into a large font after being summoned.
[Fix] Fixed the issue where the auto H/S in the gallery did not function.
[Fix] Fixed the issue with the female general's skin shader being abnormal.
[Fix] Fixed the issue with incorrect initial clothing in the gallery.
[Fix] Fixed the issue where the 81st character's props disappear.
[Fix] Fixed the issue where adjusting clothes or shoes in game mode causes model flickering.
[Fix] Fixed the issue where barefoot mode does not automatically remove shoes.
[Fix] Fixed the issue where auto function for the 51st monster in the gallery fails.
[Fix] Fixed the issue with the incorrect icon for the 5th outfit.
Developer's Note: This outfit has changed from its initial design, as our initial approach was to change clothes in sets and characters could not customize body shapes. Based on player feedback and several revisions, clothes were split into parts allowing free combination, and body shapes became customizable. The design of the 5th outfit has brought us technical difficulties:
1. Straps on the sides of the thighs: When players adjust the thickness of the thighs, the collision bodies cannot make non-linear adjustments along with the thigh thickness. This results in the straps either clipping through or floating in mid-air, which is an issue we cannot overcome, hence the straps must be removed.
2. Suspender boots: In later revisions, shoes were separated as individual accessories for players to match freely with clothes. However, since suspender boots were not separate models but integrated with the lower half of the female character, they were not compatible with the costume system, so the boots had to be removed.

We have recently tried to overcome these issues, but ultimately failed, thus maintaining the current revised state.
The redesign of the 5th outfit has taken a considerable amount of time, but the icon was never updated, causing misunderstandings among some players who thought there was an error with the outfit. We apologize to all players for this.

[Fix] Fixed the issue where loading a file in certain conditions leads to infinite falling.
[Modification] Made the button to adjust monster transparency more conspicuous.

notes.title: The 6th major update preview
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm Kazuya
Time flies, it's been two years since our Sword x Hime sale, 5 major updates, and a 6th major update is already in the works.
The 6th major update mainly focuses on the improvement of the system and game experience. The expected improvements are as follows:

1. Key Binding
Many players want the game to support Key Binding, and I promised to do it at the time, and we will fulfill this promise in the 6th major update.
This part is related to the underlying control logic. This time I will modify the underlying control logic from static to dynamic.

2. Gamepad support
More and more players of TPS games are now using Gamepad to play. In order to meet the trend, the sixth major update will also fully support Gamepad, not only in-game controls but also UI support.
This part is related to the underlying operation logic. The logic of the keyboard and mouse is different from that of the Gamepad, and the UI event reception and operation methods are also different. It is necessary to re-implement an operation dedicated to the Gamepad.

3. Memory optimization
This is partly my mistake. At that time, in order to catch up with the release date, I made a lazy decision on memory management. As a result, as the game is updated with more and more content, memory usage is getting bigger and bigger, and now it has become violent. increased to 7GB.
As a result, many players cannot start the game normally. This time I will completely renovate the bottom layer and manage the memory well.

4. Loading optimization
Like 3, I also made a lazy decision when it came to scene loading. Every scene, regardless of whether the assets in it were needed or not, was loaded all in one go. If you have a solid-state hard drive, the loading time is limited. acceptable.
But if it is a mechanical hard disk, the loading time may be as long as 20-30 seconds or even longer. This time I will manage the material of the scene and only load the part that is currently needed to reduce the loading time.

5. Performance optimization
According to our current test, with the GTX1060 graphics card at 1080P resolution, the performance is about 40fps. After analyzing all the scenes, I feel that we can manage the display of objects in more detail.
There should be room for improvement in performance, so I will also start to optimize this part to increase the fps as much as possible.

6. Game parameter adjustment
Although this game is an ARPG, the upgrade curve design is quite casual. Some players have given some suggestions, such as the drop rate of treasures, the cost of upgrading, the attack bonus after H...etc. I think it all makes sense, and these suggestions will be completed in the 6th major update.

7. Add a task list
A lot of players wanted the game to support task lists, and I promised to do it at the time, and we'll keep that promise in our sixth major update.

Since the above items are all related to the experience and optimization of the game, a lot of changes to the underlying structure will be made, and this update will be time-consuming, so we will release each item after completion.

The fourth major update theme is the struggle system and the completion of the insertion and cream-out actions of all monsters.

Struggling system:
[H’s struggling system design original intention]
Generally, mainstream games are based on the heroine's break-free system.
This time it’s designed to be a system where the player plays the monster side.
In H, the player plays the monster side, there is a battle bar, and the player can watch the struggle animation after the player's hand speed is fast enough to reach the target.
Because it was designed as a traditional player-to-break system, the player just broke free
Then it ends without seeing the animation, this ending is weird.
It should let the players enjoy themselves, let the players click, and get rewards at the same time.
When the player clicks to challenge successfully within the time limit, the battle bar will be reset to zero.
Success in each stage of the challenge will play the next stage of struggle animation.
Let players have more interaction and a sense of participation in the H element.
Then you can get corresponding rewards in this H interaction.

If the monster is difficult to win, you can rely on the method of squeezing the essence in H to become stronger.

notes.title: Sword x Hime Update Plan Part2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
Thank you for your support and encouragement. By now we have probably cleared all the bugs, and once again I apologize to all players for our negligence

Then enter the second stage, system function enhancement
During this period of time, we have received suggestions from players, many of which are very good, and we will try our best to adopt what we can, hoping to make this game meet the expectations of players
I also hope that everyone can accompany this game to grow, so next I will report to you the follow-up plan, numbering in the order of implementation

1. Mission system
The current situation of this system is very serious. Because it was planned to be launched in EA mode, this part was not tested in detail. At present, there are many BUGs of NPC. In addition to comprehensively checking whether each task process is correct, we will also check the task Complete system, plus task log and reminder functions

2. Map UI
At present, it is necessary to read the war chess table to go to each level. We feel that it is a waste of time to read repeatedly, so we will cancel the design of the war chess table and go to each level through the UI.

3. Automatic archiving
Many players have asked for the automatic save function, we will implement it

4. Underwater effect
Many players have suggested that there is no effect underwater, and the feeling is very bad, we will implement it

5. Monster translucent
Many players have proposed that the monster can become translucent to increase the sense of substitution. We will implement it

6. Joystick switch
Since the game was released, the conflict between the joystick and the mouse has continued, causing us to stop all joystick support first, so as not to affect the game. At the same time, we also removed the joystick support information on the store page, but this does not mean we give up Joystick support, we will implement a switch, the default is not to support the joystick, but after opening it will switch to the joystick

7. Custom buttons
There are not many hotkeys in this game, but there are still players who ask for custom key functions, we decided to implement it

8. Memory optimization
When the system functions are enhanced, we will optimize the memory loaded in the game

9. German and Italian language support
Thanks to the enthusiastic players who are willing to provide support in these two languages. In my country, there are few people who are familiar with these two languages. There are German and Italian players who are willing to provide assistance. We are very grateful


Finally, I would like to report to all players that in the second stage, we can’t update every day as we do now, because the development and enhancement of the system is often not completed in a day, it may take a week or even longer, please don’t get me wrong, we continue to update
In the meantime, if players find a bug, please continue to report it. I will release an emergency update or update the system together depending on the situation.

Thank you again for your tolerance and encouragement
Have a nice day

Kazuya & tensun3d
